what_this_is: measured cleavage events from idr0068, re-exported with no track-length filter

source.sha256_note: computed on the file downloaded 2026-11-08. The earlier export recorded only the byte count; the byte count matched exactly, which is why re-downloading was safe. The digest is recorded here so the next re-download is checkable without a byte-count coincidence.
source.tracker_citation: Amat et al. 2014, Nat Methods 11:951, doi 10.1038/nmeth.3036 - the GMEM/TGMM tracker whose output this is

scale.why_null: IDR records this study's physical pixel size as null. No micron scale is asserted anywhere in this module.
scale.a_temptation_not_taken: the detection cloud spans about 1088 voxels, and a zebrafish embryo at these stages is often quoted near 700 um, which would give about 0.64 um per voxel. That is an inference from a textbook figure about a different specimen, not a calibration of this recording, so it is written here and used nowhere.

parent_rule.rule: detection d in frame t has parent index p = d.parent into frame t-1's file-order list. A division is a p with exactly two children in frame t.
parent_rule.invalid_parent: a parent index is unusable if it is negative, out of range for frame t-1, or (in frame 0) self-referential. The earlier export measured 26.6 % of detections with unusable parent refs; this module recomputes it.

suspect_rule: a frame whose division rate exceeds 10x the median frame's rate. See the comment above the rule for the threshold this replaced and why.

posterior_equals_prior.what_it_means: the deposited posterior precision nu*W equals the deposited prior precision nuPrior*WPrior. See atPrior(). Measured, not assumed, and reported because a share of 1 is itself the finding.

regularisation_floor.what_it_means: no axis of any detection is allowed a precision above precision_cap, so no axis standard deviation is below sd_voxels. Sizes are bounded below by the tracker, not by the specimen.

what_the_old_export_could_draw_why: it required all three of parent, daughter A and daughter B to survive a 50-frame minimum, and a division is where tracks start and stop.

what_this_tests.claim: sim-engine/scales/micro/division.mjs animates cleavage as division WITHOUT growth: the union of the two daughters equals the parent volume at every instant, so separation is the only free parameter and the radius is solved from it.
what_this_tests.how_this_file_tests_it: volume_ratio_union over every measured division event. If division without growth holds for these nuclei, the distribution sits at 1.
what_this_tests.why_it_is_a_real_test: the constraint was written and committed before any measured division geometry existed in this project. Its prediction is a number, and these events supply that number.
what_this_tests.what_a_failure_would_mean: these are NUCLEI, not cells, and a nucleus reassembles after mitosis rather than being cleaved. A ratio far from 1 refutes "nuclear volume is conserved through division", which is a claim worth refuting, but it does not by itself refute volume conservation for the CELL - no cell boundary was imaged here.

calibration.verdict: spheres drawn at 1.5 sd are clear of their neighbours: contact would need 3.47 sd. The drawing choice is conservative by a factor of 2.31.

tracks.note: every track is kept. The 50-frame set is reported so this export can be compared with the earlier one.

normalisation.note: identical to the existing embryo-manifest.json, so divisions and the point cloud share one frame of reference
